items.title: You can finally edit an Instagram Story without deleting it

items.lede: Instagram's latest update will allow you to edit your Stories without losing your views, likes, or replies. You can now edit the text, music, stickers, and drawings for up to 15 minutes after sharing your Story, Instagram head Adam Mosseri has announced.
